_comment: RB-011 probe manifest: durable, machine-checkable claims each register a re-verification command here so `node tools/dev/run-probes.js` can execute them all at orient. needsServer=true probes are skipped (not failed) when nothing serves :3170. Add an entry whenever a doc/memory claim gains a runnable check.

probes.description: Whole DB-frontier API surface healthy (P1-P6 endpoints)
crawl-status SSR markers + emitted client script parse (template-literal trap tripwire)

fleet resolver + port inventory coherent (v2=3200 deployed, worker 8081, legacy 3120 orphaned) + Oracle v2 reachability surfaced informationally — the D1 guard against remote-config sprawl (2026-07-21, cycle 65)
churn-scan tool runs and produces JSON (RB-004)
timed-probe REFUSES an unbounded (no-LIMIT) query — the WAL-pin incident guard (expect exit 3)
dev-bridge heartbeat is fresh (bridge alive + processing) — surfaces a dead/wedged bridge at orient instead of silently piling up inbox actions

server-child resilience (supervisor + watchdog + FATAL capture) and run-multi dispatch-and-return wiring are present — a static tripwire so a refactor can't silently delete the crash/wedge guards (2026-07-20)

raw-SQL signatures outside ncdb do not exceed the ceiling — RATCHETED DOWN as delegations land (269 baseline → 258 → 249 schema-introspection helpers out of validate-url-normalization → 241 same helpers reused in normalize-fetches + normalize-place-hubs, 2026-07-21). New DB-shaped logic in core layers is a regression; lower this only when a delegation reduces the count, raise only deliberately

every improvement cycle >= the instrumentation floor (47) carries a well-formed machine-readable `<!-- cycle:{...} -->` stanza under its ledger row (cost-per-improvement + recursion + coordination-debt series). Guards the loop's own measurement record against silent rot, the same way ncdb-debt-ratchet guards raw SQL. See docs/agi/WORKFLOW_MEASUREMENT.md (2026-07-21, cycle 47)

no workflow task-type with >=5 recorded runs exceeds the cost-to-catch ceiling (turns spent per validation-CONFIRMED real catch) — a degrading/bloating workflow surface (one that stops earning its cost) is a regression, caught at orient. Bootstrapped 2026-07-21 (cycle 48) with 13 labeled runs; diagnosis=0.9, delegation-safety=1.0, equivalence=0.4. See docs/agi/WORKFLOW_MEASUREMENT.md §2 (cost-to-catch is the sound ratchet signal; verdict-accuracy is a diagnostic-to-read, not a gate, because a REFUTED verdict can be the workflow correctly refuting a bad premise)
